Where your data goes

For every Småverk tool: Captions, Vertical and Clip finder. Last updated 2026-09-20.

Your video

It stays on your device. The tools do their work inside the page, in your browser. Your video, its sound and the words in it are not sent to us or to anyone else. There is no account. Once a tool has loaded, you can turn off Wi-Fi and it still works.

What we do see

  • Page visits. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics. It counts visits without cookies and does not follow you across sites. We see which page was opened, roughly where from, and which browser. We do not see who you are. Links between our pages carry a short tag, like ?src=studio, so we can count which page sent a visit.
  • Files the tools load. The first time you use a tool, your browser downloads the files it needs to work on your device. In Vertical every one of those files comes from our own site. Captions and Clip finder still fetch the largest of them from public file hosts (content delivery networks). Those hosts see a request for a public file that anyone can download, as any web host does. Your video, its sound and your recording are not part of it and are not sent anywhere. Fonts come from our own site. Serving those last files from our own site too is work we have not done yet.
  • If you pay. Polar is our merchant of record. Polar collects your email and card details on its own page, under its own privacy policy. After you pay, the page asks a small service of ours for your key, using only the checkout id, and unlocks itself. When you open the page later, that same service is asked what the key opens and whether it is still live; the key is sent to it and to nobody else. The key is kept in your browser, so the paid version stays on that device. For another device, paste the key shown in the tool, or the one in Polar's email, into the key box there. None of this touches your video, your sound or your recording: the work the tool does makes no requests at all.
  • If you write to us at hello@smaverk.com, we keep your email to answer you.

How we make money

You pay once for the paid version of a tool. That is the whole business. The pages carry no ads and set no tracking cookies, and we do not sell or share data about you. There is little to share: your videos stay with you, and we keep no list of who used the tools.

Your rights

You can ask us what we hold about you and have it deleted. Write to hello@smaverk.com. For payment data, Polar answers as the merchant of record.
